Summary: The Justice League is a pantheon of hope led by its greatest legends—Superman and Batman. Together with a League of Heroes, they have turned a fractured world into a seamless utopia where crime is systematically dismantled. Meanwhile, at Wayne Manor, a brilliant family of rescued children thrives under the care of the world’s most celebrated power couple: Bruce Wayne and Clark Kent. From university professors and ballerinas to a new generation of cooperative heroes, the Kent-Wayne legacy stands as a monument to absolute safety, unity, and domestic bliss.  But a perfect world is never built by accident. Beneath the surface of this frictionless paradise lies an elite operation that leaves no stone unturned to guarantee global stability. It is a world where veteran protectors can finally hang up their capes with a contented sigh, knowing a disciplined younger generation is ready to take to the sky—all while the dark secret of the true price paid for this peace fades silently into history. Summary: A man comes and inspects your teeth and your hands and fingers, your bone length, your wrist width. He speaks a number to your father. Your father silently holds out his hand, and will not look at you. Clark Kent is twenty-two when the Assessor's cart comes to Smallville. Forty-two silvers, a compass, and a long road east — and the boy who grew up in the wheat fields of the Western Reaches is delivered to the imperial household of House Wayne, Sovereign of the Eastern Delta. In the palace, concubines are currency, rank is survival, and names are the first thing they take from you. Clark can't stop looking people in the eye. He gets beaten for it. He does it anyway. The Sovereign sits behind guarded doors and doesn't look at anyone. But someone inside the walls is trying to kill him — hemlock in the training house, foxglove in the tea cabinet — and the unranked tribute from a province no one considers fully human is the only person who can smell the difference between medicine and murder. Clark Kent was raised by good people in a quiet field, and that means you carry what you can for the ones you love. Even when — especially when — what you're carrying is a lie.

The city’s night light spills in through the window, illuminating Bruce’s tired face, dark circles beneath his eyes. [...] What would have happened if Batman were present in the 2025 Superman movie?

Summary: A month has passed since Jason Todd traded the cold streets of Gotham for the warmth of Wayne Manor. Between night patrols, the unconditional love of his parents (Bruce and Clark), and the chaotic relationship with his new big brother, Dick, Jason finally feels like he has a home. Years later, Jason returns from the dead consumed by deep resentment toward his family for replacing him with a new Robin.
